[ITST.5.7.1] A test's verdict is its exit status: its run
step succeeds only when the binary exits 0, and `main()`
must return non-zero when any scenario failed ([ITST.5.4]).
On success `main()` may also print a line saying so
(`test_log_spec: OK`). Nothing reads that line, so its
absence is not a failure, and a test must not rely on it
as one.
